notes.title: The first MAJOR update to the game is now live!
notes.notes:
[b]Lots of major improvements have been implemented.[/b] The two most notable additions to the game includes keyboard support and single player mode.

[b]It's now completely possible to control the entire game with keyboard and mouse[/b], if you should want to. Besides making the game available to more people, this means two major things:
[olist]
[*] You never have to plug in a controller to play the game, if you want to experience the single player mode.
[*] You can play the game in multi-player mode even if you only have one gamepad.
[/olist]

[b]Every map in the game can now be played in single player mode.[/b] This update also brings a completely new mode, that can't be played in multiplayer mode. Single player also brings CPU-controlled bots, which makes for an exciting experience even when your friends are unable to join your session.

I hope that you will enjoy this update! I look forward to hearing your feedback.
